Record Class SessionRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.who.core.domain.SessionRecord
Record Components:
id - who's id for the session, the only one ever shown
identityId - the identity that signed in
credentialId - the credential it signed in with
signInMethod - how it signed in
signedInAt - when it signed in
lastSeenAt - when it last made a request, written at most once per interval
userAgent - the browser's User-Agent at sign-in, or null when it sent none
endedAt - when it was ended (signed out, or ended from elsewhere), or null while it has not been
public record SessionRecord(UUID id, UUID identityId, UUID credentialId, SignInMethod signInMethod, Instant signedInAt, Instant lastSeenAt, String userAgent, Instant endedAt) extends Record
One browser sign-in, as who records it so a person can see where they are signed in and end a session from elsewhere. Its id is who's own, never the servlet session's id, which is the session cookie's value.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
